use: Every unit has a full kitchen, and the resort lists a private balcony among its room features.

use: None of the listings says the fee pays the power bill.

use: It has two oceanfront pools and an indoor whirlpool.

use: The resort's own rental program is part of the Vacation Myrtle Beach group.

struck: Owners get two free water-park passes a day.
use: Guests who book through the resort's own rental program get two free passes a day to H2Oasis, in season.

use: Guests may not bring pets, and a $500 fine applies; registered service animals are not counted as pets.
